title: Correlations between radiological and histological findings of bone remodelling and root resorption in a rodent cleft model
authors: Möhlhenrich SC, Kniha K, Heitzer M, Magnuska Z, Hermanns-Sachweh B, Gremse F, Chhatwani S, Hölzle F, Modabber A, Danesh, G. Head & Face Medicine, 18(1), 33. DOI 10.1186/s13005-022-00338-x
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxgraft (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Due to the lack of correlation between histological and radiological findings of bone remodelling and the development of root resorptions, both methods should be combined in this cleft model in rats for a comprehensive analysis” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
